rationale: Greek loanword ὁ νοῦν? No — Coptic ⲛⲟⲩⲛ from Egyptian Nun, the primordial waters / abyss. Paired here antithetically with ⲡⲭⲥⲉ ('the Height'). 'The Deep' preserves both the cosmological-vertical pairing and the abyssal connotation.
Lycopolitan ⲭⲥⲉ = Sahidic ϫⲓⲥⲉ 'height, elevation.' Functions as the upper cosmological pole paired with ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ. Translating as 'the Height' preserves the spatial axis.
Lycopolitan ⲭⲏⲩ = ϫⲏⲩ 'ships, vessels.' In Manichaean cosmology these are the cosmic light-vessels (sun and moon) that ferry refined light upward. Standard technical term.
ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ literally 'the whole/all of it' = the totality of being. Manichaean cosmological term for the entire cosmic system. Preserve as 'the All' (capitalized) to flag its technical sense.
Compound: ⲣⲉϥ ('one who does') + ⲣ̄-ⲛⲁⲃⲉ ('does sin') = 'sinner.' Standard form, paralleling ⲣⲉϥ†ⲥⲃⲱ ('teacher').

Lycopolitan reflex of ⲛⲍⲉⲛⲧⲟⲩ / ⲛϩⲉⲛⲧⲟⲩ 'Indians' (from Old Persian Hind-, via Aramaic). Geographical term for the inhabitants of the Indus region; matches the well-attested account of Mani's first missionary voyage to the Indus valley under Ardashir.
ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲏⲥ = the people, ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲓⲥ = the country. Standard ethnonym/toponym pair for the Iranian Sasanian heartland (Pārs/Fārs).

Latin comitatus via Greek κομιτᾶτον — the mobile imperial court of the Sasanian king. Mani is reported to have accompanied Shapur's traveling court for many years; the technical Roman/Sasanian administrative sense should be preserved.
